difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that viewing a complex of modules over an algebra of tor dimension at most d as a complex over the base ring shifts the lower end of its tor amplitude by d. The author notes that this is a special case of the general push-forward statement for tor amplitude and then gives a direct argument: a free resolution of a test module is tensored down, the derived tensor product over the base is rewritten as a derived tensor product over the algebra against the derived base change of the module, and since that base change has cohomology concentrated in a bounded range while the complex has tor amplitude in a given interval, the spectral sequence of the double complex shows the resulting cohomology is concentrated in the shifted interval.
